title: Clef-flash confirmation
finding: Confirmatory test of Experiment 38 candidate J (Clef-flash, llama.cpp Q8_0, wording W1) at a threshold frozen on Experiment 38, on 68 new documents that the shipped chain rescues with LiteParse (amendment A8); labels by Gemini 3.8 Flash with the Experiment 33 procedure (A7). Clef-flash catches 56/76 junk pages but flags 11/358 healthy pages (3.1%), misses 6 of 19 junk-layer documents (G1) and sends 6 usable documents to OCR (G2); margin over the word check +0.092, McNemar p 0.180. Word check: 49/76 junk, 1/358 healthy, G2 and G3 pass, G1 misses `rs37` only. Readable-language judge work stops (D10); standard text-quality methods untested (see report, Methods against standard practice).
